AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.title: Exusiai's Badge
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.descripti: At the start of each combat, gain {Ammo} [gold]Ammo[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_BADGE.flavor: A Rhodes Island badge. Smiles, good luck, and plenty of ammunition.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.title: Exusiai's Surprise
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.descri: At the start of each combat, gain {Ammo} [gold]Ammo[/gold] and {FirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_EXUSIAI_SURPRISE.flavor: The warmest blessing deserves the loudest surprise. BOOM!!!!!!!!!!!
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.title: Etched Round
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain {FirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_ETCHED_ROUND.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart; words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_APPLE_PIE_LOGISTICS.des: The first time you play an Attack each turn, regain the [gold]Ammo[/gold] it spent. This triggers even if it spent none.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_APPLE_PIE_LOGISTICS.fla: Delivered on time and best enjoyed warm. Ammunition, too.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.title: Boss's Medal
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.description: The first time you add [gold]Delivery[/gold] to a card each turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_BOSS_MEDAL.flavor: Best Boss Medal. Super Boss Medal. Invincible, peerless Boss Medal.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.title: Lord-Server
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.description: Whenever you obtain a Curse during combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_LORD_SERVER.flavor: Connection established. Not every prayer... necessarily receives an answer.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CONFESS_47.title: CONFESS-47
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CONFESS_47.description: At the start of each combat, add {Cards} random [gold]Angel[/gold] cards to your hand.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_CONFESS_47.flavor: Laterano autonomous confession vehicle, designation ‘CONFESS-47,’ ready to hear your confession.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.title: Fluorescent Light
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.descr: Whenever you play an [gold]Angel[/gold] card, gain {TemporaryFirepowerPower:diff()} [gold]Firepower[/gold] this turn.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FLUORESCENT_LIGHT.flavo: Laterano's light sometimes comes from a humming tube.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_RADIO.title: Firepower Radio
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_RADIO.descrip: Damage granted by [gold]Ammo[/gold] is multiplied by {Multiplier}. At the start of your turn, lose {Ammo} Ammo.
AK_EXUSIAI_RELIC_FIREPOWER_RADIO.flavor: Channel clear. Coordinates confirmed. Explosions inbound.
